name: motion-design
title_zh: 先播一遍动效再改提示词，不空想直接出片
tagline_zh: 别对着空白画布憋动效脚本。先看可播放的动效案例，再借 Higgsfield MCP 把原提示词改成你的产品片——参…
tagline_en: Stop storyboarding in the dark. Browse playable motion examples, then adapt their prompts into full product films.
desc_en: Browse playable motion-design examples and adapt their original prompts into product-specific full-film prompts or videos through Higgsfield MCP. Supports kinetic typography, glass UI launches, product films, architectural reveals, explainers, footage overlays and original concepts. References are optional; prompt review does not generate media.
why_zh: 把「看效果」和「写提示词」焊在一起：先播后改，你才知道每条提示词到底长什么样，改起来有锚点，不是盲调。
why_en: Welds preview to prompt-writing: play first, then adapt—you see what each prompt actually renders, so edits are anchored, not.
limit_zh: 只出提示词和审片，不生成视频——最终成片得靠 Higgsfield 账号自己跑。动效库偏营销向（字效、玻璃UI。
limit_en: Outputs prompts & review only—no video generation; you need your own Higgsfield account. Library skews marketing (kinetic type, glass UI, product.
title_en: Play motion examples first, then adapt prompts to full films
